counterfactual_missing_items: no mention of fever or systemic symptoms
intact bony anatomy and no fracture or dislocation
decisive_items: painful, fluctuant mass extending from the palmar web space to the A2 pulley of the fourth digit
focal tenderness over the flexor sheath and limited active digit motion
response.rationale: R2 is more specific to the location and symptoms described, with a clear indication of flexor tenosynovitis, whereas R4 is a more general diagnosis of cellulitis

rejected.why: septic arthritis is less likely due to the absence of joint involvement and the presence of a fluctuant mass
although it shares some similarities with R2, it is an append-only completion and lacks sufficient standalone support
